reason_detail: MCC held a persistent TLS connection to the real settings service (20.184.175.6:443), established during boot BEFORE the redirect, owned by the game process (MAIN_THREAD). It reused that connection and never re-resolved the hostname, so the /etc/hosts override was never consulted and the observer was never contacted. No new connection to the settings /16 appeared during a 25s observation window or the menu-navigation trigger.
mechanism_2_considered: exact-destination DNAT would only affect NEW connections; a reused ESTABLISHED connection would not be caught without forcing a reconnect, which is invasive and out of scope. Not attempted.
